text: THE HOME PAGE'S SECTIONS RUN IN THE ORDER THE DESIGN DRAWS THEM. Scheme Portals is a section of its own, where Figma puts it — under About Us, above Take a Pledge — with the six portals as cards leading on the abbreviation a citizen is actually sent to ("PM-AJAY"), the full name beneath, in the design's order rather than the registry's, and the Department's three standing figures under them. Both halves were on the page already and neither was where the design puts it: the portals were the fourth group inside Organisations, so somebody looking for somewhere to apply scrolled past three groups of commissions and corporations to reach them, and the figures were a strip at the foot of About the Department. Take a Pledge moves up to fourth, as drawn. Organisations is now "Our Organisations" and covers the commissions, corporations and bodies alone. One class name had to change on the way: `.wn-portals` already belonged to the portals explorer, whose `[data-design="next"]` prefix outranked the new rule and held the row at three columns.
